offer.title: NFC-Powered Payment Network with Venmo Rewards
offer.scope: Develop a prototype for an NFC-based payment network that rewards customers with Venmo rewards via USDC, using a hockey puck and NFC sticker. The system will include Solana onchain check-ins, Plaid for purchase verification, and Venmo as the off-ramp UX. No POS integration or merchant setup required.
